panels.description: Bi11bot projects a clean holographic mountain cross-section: Keel, Halyard and Oasis with three distinct unlettered markers. Only the Keel marker glows amber. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear for dialogue; generate no labels or text.
The bright unlettered Keel marker sits beneath the sealed mine entrance. Leave upper-left clear for the lettering label and dialogue.
Alex studies the sealed mine marker while Bi11bot stands beside him. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear for the compressed exchange.
Alex looks toward the workbench where Adrian’s hologram stood, holding the creased photograph. Bi11bot remains beside him. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Alex turns Adrian’s watch over while Bi11bot’s eye rings click toward him. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.

Alex presses his hand to the unlettered Keel marker. A thin amber line leaves the map and enters an existing infrastructure route, clearly reading as a simple Legacy Protocol alert transmission rather than artifact activation or authority transfer. Leave lower-left open.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: Your father left a trail. Three artifacts, in three places.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: He called it the Legacy Protocol.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: The first is called the Measure. It's somewhere inside the old mine.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: That mine's been sealed. I can't leave Keel.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: You don't need to. This one is under your feet.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: And finding it tells me what happened to him?

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: It tells us where to begin.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Everyone says he gambled it all away.

items.speaker: BI11BOT
items.text: That's a theory. The mine is evidence.
